ticket_types_sale_window_check.name: ticket_types_sale_window_check
ticket_types_sale_window_check.value: "ticket_types"."sale_starts_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."sale_ends_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."sale_ends_at" > "ticket_types"."sale_starts_at"

orders_paid_check.name: orders_paid_check
orders_paid_check.value: ("orders"."paid_at" IS NULL) = ("orders"."paid_amount" IS NULL) AND ("orders"."paid_at" IS NULL) = ("orders"."paid_source" IS NULL) AND ("orders"."paid_amount" IS NULL OR "orders"."paid_amount" >= 0) AND ("orders"."status" <> 'paid' OR "orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)

review_items_reason_check.name: review_items_reason_check
review_items_reason_check.value: ("review_items"."type" = 'orphan') = ("review_items"."reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("review_items"."reason" IS NULL OR "review_items"."reason" IN ('event_ended', 'event_locked', 'sold_out'))

review_items_resolution_check.name: review_items_resolution_check
review_items_resolution_check.value: ("review_items"."status" = 'resolved') = ("review_items"."resolution" IS NOT NULL) AND ("review_items"."resolution" IS NULL OR "review_items"."resolution" IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'refunded', 'dismissed'))

review_items_refund_only_check.name: review_items_refund_only_check
review_items_refund_only_check.value: "review_items"."type" NOT IN ('event_cancelled', 'duplicate_payment', 'unmatched') OR "review_items"."resolution" IS NULL OR "review_items"."resolution" IN ('refunded', 'dismissed')
